day5_lunch_chase_1.text: *I ran. Burst through the classroom door. Didn't look back.*

day5_lunch_chase_2.text: *The hallway. Fluorescent lights flicker. Footsteps echo. Mine. Yuna's. Two sets.*

day5_lunch_chase_3.text: *Yuna follows behind. Running on legs still drugged. Stumbling — but not stopping.*

day5_lunch_chase_3a.text: *— If I let go of Yuna, I could run faster. The thought flashed through my mind. I erased it immediately.*

day5_lunch_chase_5.text: *The broadcast echoes through the hallway. Ms. Eunsu's voice comes from everywhere. From the walls. From the ceiling. From beneath my feet.*

day5_lunch_chase_6.text: ...All the doors are locked. Come back.

day5_lunch_chase_7.text: *...No. There is still one place left. The place Seolhwa kept pointing to.*

day5_lunch_chase_8.text: *The sealed hallway. A fork. Left — the main building. Right — the old wing.*

day5_lunch_chase_10.text: *Footsteps from the left. — No, from the right too. 5 seconds. I have to decide in 5 seconds.*

day5_lunch_left_1.text: *End of the hallway. Sea is standing there.*

day5_lunch_left_2.text: *Arms spread, blocking the way. The sleeves of her uniform are trembling. The red glow of the emergency light illuminates only half of Sea's face.*

day5_lunch_left_3.text: *I stopped. I could push past her if I ran. — My body won't move.*

day5_lunch_left_5.text: *Sea's voice is breaking. Her eyes are already wet. She was alone in this hallway before I even got here.*

day5_lunch_left_5b.text: *Sea shook her head. She bit her lip. Blood welled up.*

day5_lunch_left_6.text: I can't let you go. Not this time.

day5_lunch_left_7.text: *Sea's hands are clenched into fists. Trembling. Whether to stop me or to hold herself together, I can't tell.*

day5_lunch_left_8.text: I hate it too. Being like this.

day5_lunch_left_9.text: But if you go through that door, the next day there's a stranger standing in front of me.

day5_lunch_left_10.text: The name tag changes, the hairstyle changes, and we start over from the first hello.

day5_lunch_left_11.text: ...On Day 1, when you said 'hello' to me. Every time that greeting — was like a knife. The greeting of a stranger.

day5_lunch_left_12.text: But still — that one greeting kept me going until the next cycle.

day5_lunch_left_13.text: *Clang. The steel door on the 1st floor of the main building rattles. Someone is coming up. Footsteps echo on the stairs.*

day5_lunch_left_14.text: That's not smiling at you. It's a stranger who doesn't know you smiling.

day5_lunch_left_20.text: There are nail marks on that corner. Twelve lines.

day5_lunch_left_22.text: Nobody counts them. Only I do.

day5_lunch_left_23.text: Every time after you passed by, I rubbed them away with my sleeve. But the marks still stayed.

day5_lunch_left_24.text: And by the next morning, the name tag on your desk was different.

day5_lunch_left_25.text: **...Do I have to step aside for the 13th time too?**

day5_lunch_left_choice.text:
*Bang bang bang. The footsteps on the stairs grow closer. Second floor. They'll be here soon. Sea's lips tremble. She glances toward the sound of the footsteps. — Still, she doesn't move aside.*

*Right before the choices appear, the third line looks like a different sentence for 0.2 seconds.*

***`3. [Residence Approved]`***
choices: "...I'm sorry. But I have to go."

day5_lunch_left_c1_1.text: *Sea presses her sleeve to the corners of her eyes. And — steps aside.*

day5_lunch_left_c1_2.text: ...I'll step aside for the 13th time too.

day5_lunch_left_c1_3.text: There won't be a next time. The 14th — won't happen. Because I won't step aside.

day5_lunch_left_c1_5.text: *Footsteps reached the end of the hallway. No time to look back.*

day5_lunch_left_c1_7.text: *Behind me — the sound of someone sinking to the floor. A school uniform brushing against the floor. And — a short, choked breath.*

day5_lunch_left_c2_2.text: *Sea's eyes went wide. Like a word she never heard in 12 cycles.*

day5_lunch_left_c2_3.text: ...If we go outside, will you remember me?

day5_lunch_left_c2_5.text: ...I don't even know what it's like out there.

day5_lunch_left_c2_6.text: *Sea looks down at her own hand. On the inside of her wrist, a red line remains, pressed in like the mark of the student council room keyring. It takes her a while to look out the window.*

day5_lunch_left_c2_7.text: ...Are there hallways like this out there?

day5_lunch_left_c2_9.text: ...That's a lie. But I'll believe it.

day5_lunch_left_c2_10.text: ...Even if outside is scary — it's probably better than here. Probably.

day5_lunch_left_c3_1.text: *...My knees give out. I sink to the floor in front of Sea. My toes won't leave the ground.*

day5_lunch_right_1.text: *Running down the hallway — I stopped. The footsteps disappeared. The ones chasing from behind. The ones echoing on the stairs. All of them.*

day5_lunch_right_2.text: *...A thick fire shutter separating the old wing hallway from the main building has come down. Someone lowered it manually. Beyond the shutter, a siren wails faintly, but it doesn't reach here.*

day5_lunch_right_3.text: *I squeezed under the shutter. Standing up — it's quiet. The only quiet place in a sealed school.*

day5_lunch_right_4.text: *The infirmary door is open. Only one fluorescent light is on. The rest are broken — no, removed. Deliberately darkened.*

day5_lunch_right_5.text: *Nurse Riin is standing by the cabinet. She's not wearing her white coat. Casual clothes. — Like she's prepared to leave.*

day5_lunch_right_6.text: *Syringes lined up in a row. Label: 'Memory Erasure Protocol #13'. Needles glint beneath the fluorescent light.*

day5_lunch_right_8.text: ...Are you here to stop me too?

day5_lunch_right_10.text: *I stepped back. My back hit the doorframe. Nowhere to run. Nurse Riin raised the syringe. A drop of liquid fell from the needle tip. — My legs went weak.*

day5_lunch_right_12.text: *Nurse Riin — slowly, deliberately slowly — set the syringe down on the sink. Clink. Metal against ceramic.*

day5_lunch_right_13.text: I'm not here to stop you.

day5_lunch_right_14.text: *Nurse Riin opened the cabinet. Vials lined up inside. She took one out and shook it. Clear liquid. Looks identical to what's in the syringes.*

day5_lunch_right_15.text: *Nurse Riin opened the cap. Brought it to her nose. Smelled it. — Then took a sip.*

day5_lunch_right_16.text: Don't look at the label. Look at the back.

day5_lunch_right_18.text: Since the 7th. After Lee Seolhwa — after that child was gone. I replaced the drugs from the board with sugar water. For 6 years.

day5_lunch_right_20.text: *Nurse Riin smiled. Not a bitter smile — an exhausted one.*

day5_lunch_right_21.text: When the 7th child — when Lee Seolhwa — was caught trying to escape with you. She screamed as they dragged her away.

day5_lunch_right_22.text: I could hear it from the infirmary. Two floors down. ...Do you know what she said?

day5_lunch_right_23.text: Normal dosage on the chart. IV code on the bottle. Numbers I adjusted on the blood draw sheet.

day5_lunch_right_24.text: The S-13 record is even emptier. Almost every activation field is blank. Because nobody tried to look at the blanks.

day5_lunch_right_25.text: *Nurse Riin leaned against the cabinet. Shoulders slumped.*

day5_lunch_right_26.text: ...I'm supposed to be a doctor. I took an oath to save people... and for 6 years I've been rummaging around in children's heads. I'm so disgusted with myself I could die.

day5_lunch_right_27.text: ...It's laughable. I took an oath to do no harm. And for 6 years I erased memories.

day5_lunch_right_28.text: After the 7th, I reduced the drug concentration. From the 8th onward, sugar water. So the memories wouldn't be fully erased.

day5_lunch_right_29.text: After the seventh time, there were two charts. One for submission. One real.

day5_lunch_right_30.text: ...So that's why your body kept knowing before you did. The hallway, the stairs, even her name.

day5_lunch_right_32.text: *Nurse Riin pulled a key from her pocket. A small silver key. The surface is worn. — Touched over and over again. For 6 years.*

day5_lunch_right_33.text: *Teacher held out the key. Her hand — isn't shaking. How long has she been waiting for this moment?*

day5_lunch_right_34.text: Old wing, 3rd floor. The emergency exit Seolhwa found. This key opens it.

day5_lunch_right_35.text: ...Eunsu doesn't know this key exists. I changed the locks myself after the 7th.

day5_lunch_right_36.text: *The shutter control panel display flashes `LOCAL OVERRIDE - R.IN`. On the student safety app map, only the right hallway of the old wing is grayed out and empty.*

day5_lunch_right_37.text: *Bang! The fire shutter shook violently. Someone is pounding from outside. Eunsu, or the 'administration,' has caught up.*

day5_lunch_right_39.text: *Riin is holding out a key. A small silver key. -- Her hand is trembling.*

day5_lunch_right_choice.text: *The fire shutter rattled again. Metal screaming.*
choices: "...How do I know this isn't another experiment?"

day5_lunch_right_c1_1.text: *I took the key. Small, cold, silver. In my hand — it feels heavy.*

day5_lunch_right_c2_1.text: *Nurse Riin paused for a moment. Then — shook her head. "I have to stay. I need to hold the shutter so Eunsu can't follow." ...She pressed the key into my hand.*

day5_lunch_right_c3_1.text: ...How do I know this isn't another experiment?

day5_lunch_right_c3_2.text: *Nurse Riin picked up a syringe and injected it into her own arm. The sugar water.*

day5_lunch_right_c3_3.text: ...You saw behind the label. Did you check?

day5_lunch_right_c3_4.text: You're right to doubt. You shouldn't trust anyone here. Me included. But the key is real. Go.

day5_lunch_right_c3_5.text: *Teacher gave a wry smile. I took the key.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_1.text: *The staircase up to the 3rd floor of the old wing. Supporting Yuna.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_2.text: *Halfway up the stairs — Seolhwa is standing there.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_3.text: *This time is different. Yuna's camera only shows the stairs. But Seolhwa is right in front of me. Clearly.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_7.text: *Seolhwa smiled. A sad, warm smile. Seolhwa sat on the stairs. Hugged her knees. — That posture. Familiar somehow. The same one I took when I broke down in front of the mirror on the night of Day 4.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_8.text: That's right. I'm not here. A year ago — I disappeared from this school.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_9.text: During the 7th cycle... I tried to escape with you. I found out this school's secret, told you everything, and we ran together.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_10.text: Back then, I was a 'facility student' at this school. Transferred from an orphanage. ...I wasn't a test subject, but I knew about the experiments.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_11.text: I passed you a note. 'You need to get out of this school. This place isn't what you think.' ...The 7th you — believed me. Right away.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_12.text: *That one sentence was enough. The lines in the documents and the scratches on the wall all pointed the same way. The rainy hallway. A cold hand. The third floor of the old wing. An unbroken window.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_13.text: *Seolhwa sat on the stairs. She hugged her knees. I remembered the chill left on the bathroom tiles on the night of Day 4.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_14.text: *Seolhwa's eyes are wet. — Tears of a hallucination. Tears that don't exist. But the pain in my chest is real.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_15.text: ...I'm sorry. For not remembering. ...We ran together in the 7th cycle. You were caught. And I — forgot.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_16.text: Without even knowing I'd left you alone, I kept smiling like it was the beginning.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_17.text: But you still left the writing behind.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_18.text: But your memory — couldn't fully erase me. Because Riin weakened the drugs.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_19.text: *There are scratches on the stairwell wall too. Arrows. Numbers. Scraped-out sentences. Every time I see them, the weight in my feet shifts before I can think.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_20.text: The sentences you left behind... I just hear them in my own voice.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_21.text: *The moment I saw the arrow on the wall, my ankle twisted first. My palm braced against the left wall.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_22.text: ...So when I saw my left hand back then—

day5_lunch_seolhwa_23.text: Because you always held the left railing.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_24.text: And the thing you kept saying—

day5_lunch_seolhwa_25.text: **Lee Seolhwa.** Don't get that name wrong.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_27.text: ...Today is different. You called my name first.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_28.text: *Light spread once more at the corners of Seolhwa's eyes. For a moment, the scratches on the stairwell wall grew sharp.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_29.text: ...The 13th time is different. Riin switched the drugs. Your memories remain.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_30.text: This time — you can get out.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_c1_2.text: I can't go out that door.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_c1_3.text: It's okay. Even if you pass through the door, carry the name with you.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_c2_2.text: *Seolhwa looked at her own hands. Her fingertips are blurry.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_c2_3.text: If you get out of here, the arrows left on the walls won't be needed anymore. Then I guess I'll gradually stop showing up too.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_c2_6.text: Even if the real Lee Seolhwa died long ago... I still saved you this time. That's enough.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_1.text: I'll guide you to the emergency exit. I know a way around Eunsu's blockades.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_2.text: *Seolhwa leads the way. Through the dark hallways of the old wing.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_3.text: *I can't hear Seolhwa's footsteps. She has no body. Only my footsteps echo in the hallway. The shoulder supporting Yuna is going numb.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_4.text: *The hallway is dark. I shone my phone light ahead. Seolhwa's back is visible — the light passes through her. Sometimes her outline flickers. Like a glitch.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_7.text: Left. This door isn't sealed. You can reach the 3rd floor through the storage passage.

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_8.text: *An old storage door. Covered in dust. I opened it. A narrow passage. Stairs visible between pipes and conduits.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_9.text: *I climbed up. One floor. Two floors. Water leaking from a pipe. Cold.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_10.text: *3rd floor. In front of the emergency exit.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_11.text: *Seolhwa is standing at the door. She turned and smiled. — Her outline flickered again. Growing dimmer.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_13a.text: *I inserted the key. Turned it. Click.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_13b.text: *Seolhwa placed her hand on the door. The lock — released from inside. A hallucination's hand opened a real lock. No — my memory knew the structure of this lock.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_14.text: *The door opened. Outside air rushed in. The cold air of dawn. — It feels like the first time I've breathed outside air since entering this school.*

day5_lunch_seolhwa_guide_15.text: *Seolhwa's hair swayed in the wind. On Yuna's camera screen, the emergency exit is empty. And yet the wind passes through the silver-white hair before my eyes.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_1.text: *From behind — footsteps. Coming up the stairs.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_2.text: *One step. One step. Slow. Not running. — As if she knew I'd be up here.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_3.text: *The footsteps grow closer. The sound of dress shoes hitting concrete. Ms. Eunsu's shoes.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_4.text: *Stopped. At the top of the stairs.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_5.text: *Ms. Eunsu appeared. Out of breath. Hair disheveled. — Not the composed appearance from the classroom.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_6.text: *Teacher steadies her breath and forces the corners of her mouth up. The usual gentle smile. But one side of her mouth trembles faintly.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_7.text: {name}. Stop there. The emergency exit side is a restricted area.

day5_lunch_eunsu_8.text: *As I backed away, the corners of Ms. Eunsu's mouth fell. The syringe in her hand caught the emergency light.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_9.text: *Sweat beads on her forehead. Dark circles under her eyes. I wasn't the only one who didn't sleep tonight. A cold wind from the emergency exit passed between us.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_10.text: The record sheets were all soaked.

day5_lunch_eunsu_11.text: There were rainy days, and there were snowy days.

day5_lunch_eunsu_12.text: But the last line was always the same. `Recovery complete`.

day5_lunch_eunsu_13.text: This time, I didn't want to write that line.

day5_lunch_eunsu_14.text: So I erased the things you hated, one by one. The menu, the seating, the hallway, the way people spoke. On record, things got quiet.

day5_lunch_eunsu_16.text: ...Even on the 13th time, my hands shook the moment you entered the classroom. Even though it was the same procedure.

day5_lunch_eunsu_17.text: Every time you checked me with eyes seeing me for the first time, another name appeared on the attendance sheet.

day5_lunch_eunsu_18.text: *Teacher stopped. In front of the emergency exit. Three meters from me.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_19.text:
*Teacher took a syringe from her pocket. Slowly. As if showing it to me.*

*The liquid inside the syringe glinted under the fluorescent light. On the label, small letters read: `RESET / S-13`. A single drop hung from the tip of the needle.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_21.text: One shot, and the procedure is over. You just have to keep your eyes closed.

day5_lunch_eunsu_22.text: I'll write you under a new name in the next attendance book.

day5_lunch_eunsu_24.text: *Only the sound of wind from the emergency exit. The border between the outside world and this school.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_26.text: *Teacher's hand is shaking. The syringe trembles. A drop falls to the floor.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_27.text: *Moisture fell from Teacher's eyes to beneath her chin. She kept holding only the syringe.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_28.text: *The air has frozen. The wind from the emergency exit. Teacher's breathing. My own breathing. Yuna stays still against the wall.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_29.text: *Syringe and emergency exit. Closed classroom and open night air.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_30.text: *All I have to do is shove her away and run. This person doesn't have the strength to catch me. — And yet my legs won't move. The tips of my feet are half turned toward the classroom. My body is obeying first.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_31.text: *Teacher took one more step closer. Now within arm's reach.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_32.text: *Seolhwa — is visible. Behind Teacher. At the bottom of the stairs. A blurry silhouette. Saying nothing. Just — watching me.*

day5_lunch_eunsu_final.text:
*The screen border flashes red. The clock reads 22:58. Two minutes left.*

*The choice text appears late, one character at a time. Only the second button completes first.*

***`...Please erase me.`***

*The other buttons follow after a delay.*
